```python
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def missingInteger(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        prefix_sum = nums[0]
        i = 1

        while i < len(nums) and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] + 1:
            prefix_sum += nums[i]
            i += 1

        present = set(nums)
        x = prefix_sum

        while x in present:
            x += 1

        return x
```
